name: Mistral La Plateforme
desc: Mistral's hosted API console for models and agents.
desc_zh: Mistral 托管的模型与智能体 API 控制台。
solves: Model integration means hunting endpoints, writing auth, absorbing each vendor's quirks, then handling fine-tuning and rollout on top. One console plus API covers it.
solves_zh: 接模型要自己找端点、写鉴权、吞下各家差异，再管微调和上线。一套控制台加 API 就够了。
best_for: You call models from code and also need fine-tuning and usage tracking in one bill.
best_for_zh: 你要在代码里调模型，还想在一张账单里管微调和用量。
notes: 官网跳转登录（302 循环），未取到公开页面
